name: Conversion copywriter
summary: Writes the words on your pages, emails and ads that get people to act: book, buy, sign up or reply. Starts from what your customers already say, backs every claim with proof, and tests the result.

changelog.note: First release: canon, research method, page structure by awareness, offers, proof, testing, and US and UK rules on fake reviews, urgency and dark patterns, with 30 checked sources.
